ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a right triangle, with the upper-right corner marked with a right angle. The hypotenuse goes from the upper left to the lower right, labeled as 18. The vertical side on the right is labeled as x. The acute angle at the lower-right corner is 52°, and this angle is located between the vertical side x and the hypotenuse 18. Reasoning: Relative to the 52° angle, side x is the adjacent side, and 18 is the hypotenuse, so use the cosine relationship: cos(52°)=x/18. Therefore x=18cos(52°). Calculating gives x≈18×0.6157≈11.082, rounded to nearest tenth is 11.1.
